items.title: Report: Over 70% of global fleets made no new petrol or diesel purchases in 2025
items.summary: Most global corporate fleets added no new diesel or petrol vehicles to their stock last year, according to non-profit organisation Climate Group.

items.title: How can brands make green claims without falling foul of the ASA?
items.summary: Following a string of high-profile rulings against brands over environmental claims, the Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) has published updated guidance aimed at helping advertisers avoid greenwashing.

items.title: Germany’s cleantech rollout behind schedule for 2030 goals
items.summary: New research has highlighted that rollouts of renewables, heat pumps and electric vehicles (EVs) are progressing in Germany, but are still below the required rates to reach 2030 climate goals.

items.title: Veolia trials new carbon capture technology in ‘UK first’
items.summary: The resource management company has successfully deployed the novel system at is site in Sheffield, which now traps up to one tonne of carbon dioxide (CO2) daily.

items.title: National Grid pledges £5m to grow future energy workforce
items.summary: National Grid has unveiled a £5m ‘Power Within Employability Fund’ to help 5,000 unemployed young people kickstart careers in key sectors like infrastructure and energy.

items.title: Q&A: Does the world need ‘carbon capture and storage’ to reach net-zero?
items.summary: When carbon dioxide (CO2) is released from a factory or power plant, the gas can be captured and permanently stored underground, preventing it from driving climate change.
